llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed memory helper, but users should understand it is meant to retain and search conversation history.

dimensions.detail: The artifact consistently presents itself as a multi-layer memory system with daily notes, a mesh graph, auto-logging, search, and compliance checks; those capabilities match the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The instructions are brief and disclose auto-logging and searchable persistent memory, but they do not define opt-in, redaction, deletion, or retention controls beyond a stated 5-day fresh-layer rotation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The submitted package contains only a non-executable SKILL.md file and no bundled scripts, binaries, dependencies, or install hooks.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The described memory files and commands are proportionate for a memory skill, and there is no artifact evidence of unrelated local file indexing, credential access, network exfiltration, or destructive behavior.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Persistence is central to the skill and is disclosed through memory/fresh/today.md and memory/mesh.json, but users should treat auto-logged interactions as potentially sensitive stored data.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agent memory workflow that may record prompts and replies for later search. Avoid using it with secrets or sensitive personal/business data unless you have clear controls for where the memory files are stored, how to disable logging, and how to delete retained entries.
llm.findings: [SQP-2] expected: The scanner concern is supported in the limited sense that the skill advertises auto-logging and persistent searchable memory without detailed retention or deletion controls; however, this behavior is disclosed, purpose-aligned, and the artifact contains no executable auto-run mechanism, so it does not justify Review by itself.
